name: CreateHybridCloudCluster

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID

parameters.help_en: The list of available ports for the HTTP protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, use the port1,port2,port3 format
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: http_ports

parameters.help_en: The list of available ports for the HTTPS protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, use the port1,port2,port3 format
parameters.help_zh: HTTPS协议的可用端口列表。 取值为字符串， 多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: https_ports

parameters.help_en:
The network access mode. Valid values:
internet: Internet access.
vpc: Private network access over Express Connect
parameters.help_zh:
网络接入模式。取值范围如下：
internet：公网接入。
vpc：专线私网接入
parameters.name: access_mode

parameters.help_en:
The region for Express Connect access. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Hangzhou.
cn-beiijng: Beijing.
cn-shanghai: Shanghai
parameters.help_zh:
专线接入区域。取值范围如下：
cn-hangzhou : 杭州。
cn-beiijng : 北京。
cn-shanghai : 上海
